title: <50ns Publish, <100ns Deliver, 0 Allocations Per Frame
body: The internal event/message bus used for inter-device communication (e.g., VIC-II asserting IRQ on the CPU, CIA timer underflow signaling the SID) shall achieve sub-100ns latency with zero managed heap allocations. This pub/sub system is the backbone of the emulation's device interconnect and fires hundreds of thousands of times per second.
